  • (.*?)
    • ', re.S) METER = re.compile(r"(\d+):(\d\d):(\d\d)\s*·\s*(\d+)\s*calls\s*·\s*\$([\d.]+)") def get(url, as_json=True): req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": UA}) with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=8) as r: body = r.read().decode() return json.loads(body) if as_json else body def text(fragment): return html.unescape(re.sub(r"\s+", " ", re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", fragment))).strip() def parse_fragment(markup): """-> (running_now_total or None, [row dicts]). Layout-tolerant: pulls team, kind, phase and the 'hh:mm:ss · N calls · $x' meter from each row.""" total = None m = re.search(r"Running now\s*·\s*(\d+)", text(markup)) if m: total = int(m.group(1)) 60 + int(s), calls=int(calls), cost=float(cost)) rows.append(row) return total, rows class State: def __init__(self, challenge, us): self.challenge, self.us = challenge, us self.lock = threading.Lock() self.runs, self.finished = {}, [] self.live = {} # stats / tokens / leaderboard / activity, latest self.running_total = None self.listed = 0 self.polled_at = 0 self.errors = {} cost=r["cost"]) s = [now, r["secs"], r["calls"], r["cost"]] if not run["samples"] or run["samples"][-1][1:] != s[1:]: run["samples"].append(s) del run["samples"][:-MAX_SAMPLES] for rid in self.running_total, "listed": self.listed, "runs": list(self.runs.values()), "finished": self.finished, "live": self.live, "errors": self.errors, })) def poll_stage(st, every=5.0): while True: t0 = """Vercel function: one JSON snapshot of the public stage data. Reads only public, unauthenticated pages: the stage fragment the stage page itself polls, plus /v1/challenges//{stats,tokens,leaderboard,activity}. Stateless; the page builds run history in the viewer's browser. Responses are cached at the edge for a few seconds so many viewers cost one upstream poll. """ import html, json, os, re, ssl, time, urllib.request from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler BASE = "https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai" CHALLENGE = os.environ.get("CHALLENGE", "rfq") UA = "error404ai-dashboard/0.1 (team monitor)" ROW = re.compile(r'
  • (.*?)
    • ', re.S) METER = re.compile(r"(\d+):(\d\d):(\d\d)\s*·\s*(\d+)\s*calls\s*·\s*\$([\d.]+)") # python.org builds ship without CA roots; use the macOS bundle when running locally. _CA = "/etc/ssl/cert.pem" CTX = ssl.create_default_context( cafile=_CA if os.path.exists(_CA) and not os.environ.get("SSL_CERT_FILE") else None) def get(url, as_json=True): req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": UA}) with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=8, context=CTX) as r: body = r.read().decode() return json.loads(body) if as_json else body def text(fragment): return html.unescape(re.sub(r"\s+", " ", re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", fragment))).strip() def parse_fragment(markup): """-> (running_now_total or None, [row dicts]); pulls team, kind, phase and the 'hh:mm:ss · N calls · $x' meter from each row.""" m = re.search(r"Running now\s*·\s*(\d+)", text(markup)) total = int(m.group(1)) if m else None rows = [] for rid, inner in ROW.findall(markup): who = re.search(r'class="who">(.*?)', inner, re.S) kind = re.search(r'class="kind">(.*?)', inner, re.S) phase = re.search(r'class="phase">(.*?)\s*(?:.*?', "", phase.group(1))).lstrip("· ").strip() mt = METER.search(text(inner)) if mt: h, mi, s, calls, cost = mt.groups() row.update(secs=int(h) * 3600 + int(mi) * 60 + int(s), calls=int(calls), cost=float(cost)) rows.append(row) return total, rows def snapshot(): api = lambda n: get(f"{BASE}/v1/challenges/{CHALLENGE}/{n}") jobs = { "fragment": lambda: get(f"{BASE}/challenges/{CHALLENGE}/stage.fragment", False), **{n: (lambda n=n: api(n)) for n in ("stats", "tokens", "leaderboard", "activity")}, } out, errors = {}, {} with ThreadPoolExecutor(5) as pool: futs = {k: pool.submit(f) for k, f in jobs.items()} for k, f in futs.items(): try: out[k] = f.result() except Exception as e: errors[k] = str(e) total, rows = parse_fragment(out.pop("fragment", "")) for e in out.get("leaderboard", {}).get("entries", []): e.pop("members", None) e.pop("history", None) return {"at": time.time(), "running_total": total, "rows": rows, "live": out, "errors": errors} class handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler): def do_GET(self): body = json.dumps(snapshot()).encode() self.send_response(200) self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json") self.send_header("Cache-Control", "public, s-maxage=3, stale-while-revalidate=5") self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body))) self.end_headers() self.wfile.write(body) if __name__ == "__main__": # local check: prints one snapshot print(json.dumps(snapshot(), indent=1)[:1500])
